title: Mixed Event — Resonating with you — Episode1 Hidden Feelings

meta.Event Outline: Ichika and the others learn that Shiho has been scouted by another band. Shiho is finally able to express what she's been feeling, but how will her bandmates respond?

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You've been doing street performances, Ichi?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, Miku suggested that I needed to play in front of other people to get better.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is that what Miku was talking about? Secret training equaled street performances?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No wonder it felt like you were singing and playing so much better than before!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. It felt so good to drum along to that. Your voice carried so much more power and made us come together as one...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
She's right.
But it wasn't just Ichika. All of you have been working very hard.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly. You've gotten much better too, Honami, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We have...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Teehee. We have Shiho to thank for that♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I still think you need more work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shihooo...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone has definitely gotten a lot better. Ichika especially, and has that look in her eye when she sings now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That STANDOUT show was so good. They looked like a band that was about to go pro and make it big.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If only we could play like they did...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, isn't it about time we tried doing our own show?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, we've been practicing so hard. Don't you want other people to come see us perform?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'd like that too.
A show with all of us in it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It sounds fun, but I'm also a little scared...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've played in front of an audience during recitals with the brass band, but it'll be our first time playing as a band so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I understand, Honami. I felt the same way until just recently...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then it all changed after I started doing street performances. It was so much fun having other people hear my music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You'll feel nervous at first too, but I feel that you'll want to keep playing more and more after you give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. If you say so, Ichika, I'll give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Ichika's changed quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All thanks to Miku's secret training, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't do anything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika did that all on her own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, then it's settled! We're doing a show! But where is the next question...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I would say the School Festival, but that's still a long way off so...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (A show...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm happy that we've finally reached this point...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But is it okay for us to perform on stage just for fun like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyone have any good ideas...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, you work at a live house.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would it be possible for us to play there? Maybe you could ask...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can we table that idea for now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Shiho.
I know that we're still not playing at the level you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I believe that as long as we keep practicing, we'll become even better in time for our show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's not the issue.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get that you've been working really hard and have actually gotten a lot better, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Everyone has, and we're playing better as a unit now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's something I need to deal with first...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, but I'm gonna need some time to myself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have to get to work too. Bye...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's going on with Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe I'm still not ready...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it's not just you. I still haven't reached where she wants me to be yet either.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel like something else is bothering her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's hard to say what's on Shiho's mind. It might be best for us to just wait and give her some time. We should still have time to talk to her after that, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, we might not know when we'll be doing our show right now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But how about we keep practicing so that we'll be ready to play whenever?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we keep getting better, I'm sure she'll say yes to performing in a show with us too♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like someone's ready to go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course!
Putting on a show with everyone is gonna be so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But what should we do to get stage ready?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Street performances together might be a little tough...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Moving a drum kit around would be pretty rough and it'll probably be hard to find a good spot...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Practicing may not be the only key to getting better, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Seeing someone else perform can also give you a better idea of what you need to do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's right. Shows are all about having the audience see you perform, so you have to think about what you want them to see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You can check out how other bands sound and do just that by seeing their shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see. Come to think of it, we haven't really done that. We've just been practicing like there's no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then how about we go see a show today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, how about we go to that live house Shiho works at then?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. The fact that she has work today probably means someone is playing today too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan. Let's go!
